test_environment: Actual production strategy bytecode with explicitly controllable external protocol mocks. Identity and configured rational conversion rates are assumptions, not proofs of external deployments.
candidate_tests: StrategyCandidateFailures.t.sol retains desired properties likely to fail. Each failure requires runtime reproduction and threat-model triage.

external_property_mapping.STR-FEE-ABSTRACT-WITHDRAW: Governance agent owns real AlchemistTokenVault/AlchemistETHVault tests
external_property_mapping.STR-FEE-ABSTRACT-TOTAL: Governance agent owns real AlchemistTokenVault/AlchemistETHVault tests

bounded_domains: Most amount parameters span uint64, with explicit additions such as +1 or +1e15. The source permits larger uint256 values. These tests do not prove their behavior.
Token decimals are concrete in each fixture. Oracle conversion tuples are (18,18,18), (18,18,8), (6,18,8), (6,18,18), with overflow probes at 78 and 255. Euler also probes 77.
Ordinary oracle conversion tests use rate two in oracle units. Most external protocol conversions use identity rates, with explicit rates two, three and 1.5 for rounding checks.
StakeDAO symbolic lemmas and production fuzz refinements use documented fixed floor/virtual-price settings. Constructor and zero-price rejection tests do not extend the numeric proof domain.
Tokemak custom route tests use an empty route array. The external router implementation and arbitrary route bytes remain outside the model.
StakeDAO revert-data cases use lengths 0,4,32,64. Arbitrary payload lengths remain outside the enumerated symbolic domain.
Owner/vault guards use symbolic caller addresses with only the relevant authorized role excluded. Other address dependencies are concrete fixture addresses.

semantic_gaps_without_tests.gap: Reentry is tested for a router callback into allocate. Combined malicious-token callbacks and reentry into every other selector lack dedicated sequence tests.
Zero returned mint amounts are tested and rejected. A dependency that returns a positive share amount without minting those shares lacks a dedicated negative test.

proof_claim: None. Generated tests, model lemmas and concrete witnesses are not solver results. Per-property subclaim gaps remain explicit.

formatter_recovery.method: Own pre-format generator and source-writing transcript replay in an isolated directory.

execution_note: No Halmos run. The final one-case Forge fixture check passed 1352 functions and failed 1; candidate tests were excluded. Individual smoke results are not formal proofs.
